Property Tax Reform
On Friday, December 19, Governor DeWine signed into law five tax reform bills that complete the largest tax reform in fifty years. Auditor Yoder, as a member of the County Auditors Association of Ohio (CAAO) has helped advocate for these reforms and applauds the legislature and the Governor in implementing these reforms. While more work does need to be done, this first step will result in about $2 Billion dollars in property tax savings for homeowners.

Putting government transparency at your fingertips.
Our new online tool provides information about where your taxes are making a difference. Users can now see the impact of the new values on local government revenue. View our Local Government Revenue Impact page and begin by selecting an item from the dropdown menu.
The Ohio Checkbook serves as the singular and most trusted resource for Ohioans to obtain both local and state financial information.
Ohiocheckbook.com and Ohio's Interactive Budget. The collective effort enhances government transparency by providing real-time state financial and transactional data. Users can view online government spending, as well as how revenue is allocated.

Welcome to Trumbull County Auditor
For individuals who are not comfortable entering the building, the Trumbull County Auditor’s Office will still provide 24 hour/7 day a week online options to complete title searches and valuation queries. Also, business through the Auditor’s office can still be completed internally as business documents may be mailed in or dropped off in the Auditor’s lock box located in the vestibule of the Trumbull County Administration Building. Any documents that are e-filed will be dealt with as they arrive. Any documents can be dropped off in the vestibule. Please seal all envelopes and if needed include return postage.
Martha C. Yoder | Trumbull County Auditor
